hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 AM to 7 PM
pricing: Priced by how much of the truck the load fills. Single items usually start around $99, a full truck is around $550. Exact price is confirmed on site before any work starts, or from a photo by text.
notes: Same-day and next-day pickups are often available. Licensed and insured. Takes card, cash and Venmo. Crew does all the lifting.
